  - region "Simple English explanation of Position Vectors":
    - paragraph: In simple English
    - heading "Understand Position Vectors" [level=2]
    - paragraph: "A position vector OA starts at the origin and ends at A. If A is (2,3) then OA=<2,3>. A free vector with the same components can start elsewhere. A useful rule is Position Vectors: OP=(x,y). You can learn Position Vectors by trying one small example instead of long theory."
    - paragraph: "Place the tail at O, the tip at the named point, and write the components of that tip. Example: Find the position vector of P(5,-2). Start at origin. Move to (5,-2). So the answer is (5,-2)."
    - paragraph: "In real life, maps: A location can be measured from an origin. Watch out: Starting a position vector away from the origin. Position vectors start at (0,0)."
    - complementary:
      - generic: Try this example
      - paragraph: Find the position vector of P(5,-2).
